question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Selection Day’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aravind Adiga** is the author of the book '**Selection Day**'.
 
• He is an Indian writer and journalist, and his debut novel, **The White Tiger**, won the 2008 Man Booker Prize.
 
• **Selection Day** is a novel about cricket and the lives of two brothers in Mumbai.
 
• The book explores themes of ambition, family dynamics, and the socio-economic challenges in contemporary India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aravind Adiga** was born on** 23 October 1974** in Chennai, India.
 
• He studied at Columbia University and the University of Oxford.
 
• Before becoming a novelist, Adiga worked as a journalist, writing for publications such as the **Financial Times**, and **TIME**.
 
• His works are known for their incisive critique of social issues in India.
 
• Besides **The White Tiger** and **Selection Day**, Adiga has also authored other books like **Between the Assassinations** and **Last Man in Tower**.
